Whether you're a beginner or advanced, this is the perfect way to learn naturally and speak with confidence. Ready to bring your favorite shows and movies to life? Let’s watch  speak and learn !

teacher_info.introduction:
I have been teaching English as a Second Language online for 4 years now and I can honestly say it's the best job I've ever had! I have had many happy, successful students reach both their professional and personal English language goals and improve their lives in fascinating ways. I am passionate about seeing my students make progress and it's evident in my teaching. 

I have lived all over the United States and have extensive education - Journalism, Social Work, Theology - and diverse experiences with many of the cultures that make America such a unique place to live! I have worked as a journalist, a counselor, and as an English teacher both online and at university in the US. My English teaching specializations are oral communication, editing, and writing. I am an excellent writer and speaker with a clear accent and steady pace that my students can easily understand. My vocabulary is upper advanced. I pay close attention to details that make speaking and writing English an art. 

Everyone learns in different ways and at differing speeds, so I design my lessons individually based on the students needs, my suggestions, and together we formulate a uniquely designed learning experience just for you! My students are business professionals, PhD candidates, teachers - I can teach at any level. My students make actual, measurable progress. 

I've traveled in Europe, lived in Puerto Rico, and have extensive experience teaching English to students from all over the world! I love learning about other cultures. I am available 7 days per week. I look forward to working with you!

teacher_info.teaching_style:

teacher_info.about_teacher:
My main goal is to find interesting articles, videos, movies, or music that we can discuss together in class.
I believe that language learning happens fastest when we enjoy the material and it's relevant to our lives. If we just memorize textbook phrases or vocabulary lists that are boring to us, we'll never remember anything! But if you want to talk about the amazing movie you watched last weekend, your favorite music, or the funny story that happened to you when you were with your friends, learning will happen much more easily.
I'm happy to provide quizzes, tests, or test-prep for any students who request it. I want to provide whatever is best for your personal learning style.
teacher_info.teaching_style: I teach lower intermediate- upper advanced learners of English using interesting news articles and videos about the latest global developments as well as pop-culture/entertainment. These materials have double benefits. Not only will you receive valuable English practice, but you will also be using materials directly related to your daily life that will be useful in allowing you to interact naturally and fluently with native speakers. The variety of news articles will also allow you to learn about a wide array of new topics and learn new vocabulary at a much faster rate. I will teach whatever topics interest my students - Cooking, Literature, Fashion, Video Games - Anything is okay!

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational Skills
pro_course_detail.description:
Practice your speaking skills with a native speaker. Get corrections in real time and get the chance to learn about fun, new topics.
In your first lesson with me, we will have casual conversation where we will discuss your goals while also getting to know one another. I will offer corrections and explanations as needed and I *always* encourage questions. In future lessons we might also use videos (I love TedTalks), articles, and other tools like tongue twisters and games to challenge & improve your language skills.

I know practicing your non-native language can be a little scary and I strive to make sure my students always feel comfortable in class with me. First and foremost, I never expect perfection. In fact, I love mistakes! Mistakes are one of our greatest teachers. 

I like to keep a casual, low-stress environment during lessons while always being sure to provide constructive corrections to keep you progressing.

Note for lessons with kids: I find that I am most effective working with adults but I will work with young adults pending prior approval. If you are interested in booking lessons for your child, please message me before booking.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
I have been teaching languages since 2013. I am TEFL and TEYL certified. I also know from my own experience as a student that meeting with a tutor can be scary. So I like to keep my classes as relaxed as possible while still being professional.

Each student has different goals and learning styles, so my first goal as a teacher is to get to know you better. I want to give my students skills that are relevant to their lives and interests.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching philosophy: I firmly believe that ANY person can learn ANY language. I also believe that people today don’t just learn by reading, but also by observing, watching, interacting and discussing.

Student Talking Time: I work to let my student talk as much as possible, so they get the practice they need and build their confidence in the language. Instead of talking a lot myself, I like to ask questions that get my students thinking and expressing themselves.

Variety: A bored student doesn't learn, so I like to keep things interesting by talking about topics that are important to YOU.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
English is such an expressive language, and as the global ‘lingua franca’, I believe everyone has something to gain in learning and mastering the English language.  

In high school, I was in English honors, and as silly as it sounds - I consider that one of my crowning achievements in life.  

As a person, I am generally very liberal and open-minded in my worldview perspective. I am also patient, and above all love to learn about new topics across many fields. 

I also have extensive experience in proofreading and revising English writing, from university essays to work proposals.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching method is all about flexibility and adaptability.  

My goal is to make you feel at ease, comfortable and above all relaxed in our conversational space. Ultimately, I aim to boost your confidence level and proficiency in English – be it conversationally in social settings among friends and family, public speaking or even in your career among peers and colleagues!

I am always open to suggestions - for instance, if you wish to analyze and discuss passages, news articles or even academic papers, we can definitely do that.

Additionally, I will provide corrections to certain words, phrases or sentences for your improvement. Let's have a chat and talk about the world! See you!

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English: Casual, Seamless and Engaging!
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you ready to take the leap to improve and practice your English conversational skills? My lessons are easygoing and rest assured you are in a very safe environment. I will be evaluating your level of proficiency through casual talks and interesting topics, which I assure you will be engaging, natural and organic! From there we will gradually improve with each lesson.

My teaching method is specifically catered to your needs, interests and pace of learning. I will incorporate a few activities such as reading, vocabulary, listening, games and quizzes to keep it light, practical and engaging - or we can just have free talk, it's up to you!
